title: The Heritage Stamp  (遗产保护印章)

segments.t: 二十分钟后，在九号房间里，遗产检查员检查了每一扇窗户、出口、书篮和茶杯——然后阿瑟和汉娜拿着一张盖了章的白色证书，走向钢琴旁的伊芙琳！先完整听一遍吧。
Evelyn! Look at the round blue stamp at the bottom of Arthur's page!
Approved! Official Neighborhood Heritage Cafe and Guesthouse: lease protected!
Congratulations, Arthur! What did the clerk say about Room Nine?
She drank a whole cup of mint tea, ate every crumb of lemon tart, and smiled!
She said restoring a hidden first-floor sunroom instead of building walls was genius!
And Tessa watching proudly from her cushion at the kitchen doorway saw the whole thing!
Before the clerk walked out to Linden Street, she asked if the walnut piano really works.
Play it for all of us right now, Evelyn: my aunt's finished 'Courtyard Waltz'!
Open the courtyard windows wide, Hannah, so Tessa and the whole house can hear.
Windows wide open, afternoon breeze coming in. Whenever you are ready, Evelyn!
Listen to those first four notes floating out under our tree...
For your aunt, Arthur, and for Room Nine.
现在，让我们仔细学学这些庆祝成功时的生动表达。
Evelyn! Look at the round blue stamp at the bottom of Arthur's page!
「伊芙琳！看阿瑟那张纸底部的蓝色圆印章！」 这是一个多义词，
round blue stamp
在这里指官方的印章，就像信封上的邮票一样。
Approved! Official Neighborhood Heritage Cafe and Guesthouse: lease protected!
「批准了！官方社区遗产咖啡馆和客栈：租约受保护！」 在市政文件的开头，这个单独的过去分词
Approved
概括了市政厅的最终许可。
Congratulations, Arthur! What did the clerk say about Room Nine?
「祝贺你，阿瑟！那位办事员对九号房间怎么说？」 和我们中文里说的“恭喜！”一样，这句感叹语
Congratulations
总是带着复数的 s。
She drank a whole cup of mint tea, ate every crumb of lemon tart, and smiled!
「她喝了整整一杯薄荷茶，吃掉了最后一点柠檬挞的碎屑，然后笑了！」 另一个需要记住的不发音的尾辅音：在
every crumb
里面的字母 b 永远不发音。
She said restoring a hidden first-floor sunroom instead of building walls was genius!
「她说，不去建隔断墙，而是修复底楼一个隐藏的阳光房，简直是个天才之举！」 在介词短语 instead of 的后面，动词总是要求变成 -ing 形式，就像
instead of building walls
用来翻译我们的“而不是去建墙”。
And Tessa watching proudly from her cushion at the kitchen doorway saw the whole thing!
「而泰莎在厨房门口的垫子上自豪地看着，目睹了整个过程！」 不要和门（door）混淆，这个词
the kitchen doorway
指的是门框所在的开口空间，不管门是开着还是关着。
Before the clerk walked out to Linden Street, she asked if the walnut piano really works.
「办事员走到林登街之前，问这架胡桃木钢琴是不是真的能弹。」 在提到木制家具时，木材的名称往往直接作为名词放在前面，
the walnut piano
用来描述这架琴的材质。
Play it for all of us right now, Evelyn: my aunt's finished 'Courtyard Waltz'!
「就在这里为我们所有人弹一首吧，伊芙琳：我阿姨完成了《庭院华尔兹》！」 放在句子里，强调不只是为某个人，
for all of us
而是把在场的所有人都包容在这个温馨的时刻里。
Open the courtyard windows wide, Hannah, so Tessa and the whole house can hear.
「把庭院窗户开大点，汉娜，好让泰莎和整个屋子都能听到。」 副词 wide 在这里的作用是强调开窗的程度：
windows wide
不只是打开，而是完全敞开。
Windows wide open, afternoon breeze coming in. Whenever you are ready, Evelyn!
「窗户大开，午后的微风吹进来了。你准备好了随时可以开始，伊芙琳！」 这个词在邀请别人开始做某事时非常体贴，
Whenever you are ready
意思是“随你的便，不着急”。
Listen to those first four notes floating out under our tree...
「听前四个音符飘荡在我们的树下……」 在英语中，当序数词和基数词连用时，顺序是这样的：
first four notes
first（前）放在 four（四个）前面。
For your aunt, Arthur, and for Room Nine.
「献给你阿姨，阿瑟，也献给九号房间。」 介词 for 在这里承载了深深的情感：
For your aunt
表示这首曲子是对阿瑟阿姨的致敬。让我们再来听一遍九号房间里这个充满音乐的胜利时刻吧。
Evelyn! Look at the round blue stamp at the bottom of Arthur's page!
Approved! Official Neighborhood Heritage Cafe and Guesthouse: lease protected!
Congratulations, Arthur! What did the clerk say about Room Nine?
She drank a whole cup of mint tea, ate every crumb of lemon tart, and smiled!
She said restoring a hidden first-floor sunroom instead of building walls was genius!
And Tessa watching proudly from her cushion at the kitchen doorway saw the whole thing!
Before the clerk walked out to Linden Street, she asked if the walnut piano really works.
Play it for all of us right now, Evelyn: my aunt's finished 'Courtyard Waltz'!
Open the courtyard windows wide, Hannah, so Tessa and the whole house can hear.
Windows wide open, afternoon breeze coming in. Whenever you are ready, Evelyn!
Listen to those first four notes floating out under our tree...
For your aunt, Arthur, and for Room Nine.
页面上蓝色的遗产印章墨迹已干，租约安全了，而《庭院华尔兹》也第一次飘出了敞开的绿色百叶窗外！我们下个场景见！
Goodbye!
